name: Machu Picchu
blurb: Conversation about Machu Picchu is up 234% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
